nativeCounterExplanation: For this recorded Linux4.4.0 source, libpcap_read returns record-header offset, file.c computes f_datalen=offset+cap_len, ui/summary.c copies it to file_length, Properties formats that counter. Do not equate this16byte-lower UI counter with filesystem bytes or infer truncation from that difference.
scope: Read-only accounting of this exact existing file. The GUI counter must still be read from its actual approved native pixels.
